% \pgfplotstableread (inline, with row sep) and \pgfplotstableset before
% the axis; the axis plots the loaded table twice. Behaviour V11.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\pgfplotstableread[row sep=\\]{n s1 s2\\ 1 2 3\\ 2 4 1\\ 3 3 2\\ 4 5 4\\}\loaded
\pgfplotstableset{col sep=semicolon}
\begin{axis}[title={Loaded table}]
  \addplot table [x=n, y=s1] {\loaded};
  \addplot table [x=n, y=s2] {\loaded};
  \addplot table {
    p;q
    1;1
    4;2
  };
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
